enrichment.headline: Lets Open'Hood Inc. film a documentary in OUSD schools at no cost to the district
enrichment.summary: The district agrees to let Open' Hood Inc. film a documentary about the social issues in education and in Oakland Unified. The film crew may interview and record staff, students, teachers and parents or guardians. The agreement lasts up to two years at no cost to the district, with work scheduled to start November 25, 2019, before this approval.
